name: Potion of Healing
desc: Drink it to regain 2d4 + 2 hit points. Drinking it, or feeding it to someone within 5 ft, takes an action.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
desc: Drink it to regain 4d4 + 4 hit points.

name: Potion of Superior Healing
desc: Drink it to regain 8d4 + 8 hit points.

name: Potion of Supreme Healing
desc: Drink it to regain 10d4 + 20 hit points.

name: Potion of Heroism
desc: For an hour: 10 temporary hit points and the benefit of bless, without needing concentration.

name: Potion of Resistance
desc: For an hour: resistance to one damage type (decided when it's found or bought).

name: Potion of Invulnerability
desc: For a minute: resistance to every type of damage.

name: Potion of Climbing
desc: For an hour you climb as fast as you walk, with advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb.

name: Potion of Fire Breath
desc: For an hour, a bonus action lets you breathe fire at a target within 30 feet: DC 13 Dexterity save, 4d6 fire damage (half on a save). Three breaths, then it's spent.

name: Potion of Hill Giant Strength
desc: For an hour your Strength is 21 (no help if it's higher already): Strength attacks and damage hit harder.

name: Potion of Speed
desc: For a minute you are hasted as by the spell (no concentration needed): +2 AC, double speed and an extra action each turn.

name: Potion of Invisibility
desc: For an hour you are invisible, along with what you wear and carry. It ends early if you attack or cast a spell.

name: Elixir of Health
desc: Cures any disease and ends the blinded, deafened, paralyzed and poisoned conditions.

name: Oil of Sharpness
desc: Rubbing it onto a slashing or piercing weapon takes a minute (so not in a fight). For an hour the weapon is magic, with +3 to attack and damage rolls.

name: Spell Scroll (cantrip)
desc: Read it to cast the cantrip written on it, if that spell is on your class's spell list. The scroll crumbles afterwards. Save DC 13, attack +5.

name: Spell Scroll (1st level)
desc: Read it to cast the 1st-level spell written on it, if the spell is on your class's spell list. The scroll crumbles afterwards. Save DC 13, attack +5.

name: Spell Scroll (2nd level)
desc: Read it to cast the 2nd-level spell written on it, if the spell is on your class's spell list. If you can't yet cast spells of that level, you must succeed on a DC 12 check with your spellcasting ability. Save DC 13, attack +5.

name: Spell Scroll (3rd level)
desc: Read it to cast the 3rd-level spell written on it, if the spell is on your class's spell list. If you can't yet cast spells of that level, you must succeed on a DC 13 check with your spellcasting ability. Save DC 15, attack +7.

name: Spell Scroll (4th level)
desc: Read it to cast the 4th-level spell written on it, if the spell is on your class's spell list. If you can't yet cast spells of that level, you must succeed on a DC 14 check with your spellcasting ability. Save DC 15, attack +7.

name: Spell Scroll (5th level)
desc: Read it to cast the 5th-level spell written on it, if the spell is on your class's spell list. If you can't yet cast spells of that level, you must succeed on a DC 15 check with your spellcasting ability. Save DC 17, attack +9.

name: +1 Weapon
desc: Attack and damage rolls with it get +1.

name: +2 Weapon
desc: Attack and damage rolls with it get +2.

name: +3 Weapon
desc: Attack and damage rolls with it get +3.

name: Moon-Touched Sword
desc: Glows with faint moonlight in the dark, and counts as magical for beating resistances (Xanathar's Guide).

name: Weapon of Warning
desc: Attuned and on your person: advantage on initiative.

name: Flame Tongue
desc: Attuned: speak its command word (a bonus action) and the blade bursts into flame, adding 2d6 fire damage to every hit and lighting 40 feet brightly and 40 more dimly. The same bonus action puts it out.

name: Javelin of Lightning
desc: Once a day, throw it and speak its word: it becomes a 5-foot-wide bolt of lightning to a target up to 120 feet away. Others in the line make a DC 13 Dexterity save (4d6 lightning, half on a save); the target takes the javelin's damage plus 4d6 lightning on a hit.

name: Vicious Weapon
desc: Roll a 20 on the attack and the critical hit deals an extra 2d6 damage of the weapon's type.

name: Dagger of Venom
desc: A +1 dagger. Once a day, as an action, black poison coats the blade for a minute: the next creature it hits makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 2d10 poison damage and is poisoned for a minute.

name: Sun Blade
desc: A sword hilt. A bonus action makes a blade of sunlight spring from it (or vanish): a +2 longsword with finesse that deals radiant damage, 1d8 more radiant to undead, and lights 15 feet brightly and 15 more dimly. Proficiency with shortswords or longswords counts.

name: Mace of Disruption
desc: Fiends and undead take 2d6 extra radiant damage from it; one left with 25 hit points or fewer makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is destroyed. Held, it sheds bright light 20 feet and dim light 20 more.

name: Giant Slayer
desc: A +1 axe or sword. A giant it hits takes 2d6 extra damage of the weapon's type and must make a DC 15 Strength save or fall prone.

name: Dragon Slayer
desc: A +1 sword. Dragons it hits take 3d6 extra damage of the weapon's type.

name: +1 Ammunition
desc: Priced per piece. Attack and damage rolls made with it get +1. A piece that hits loses its magic (you can still pick it up as ordinary ammunition).

name: +2 Ammunition
desc: Priced per piece. Attack and damage rolls made with it get +2. A piece that hits loses its magic.

name: +3 Ammunition
desc: Priced per piece. Attack and damage rolls made with it get +3. A piece that hits loses its magic.

name: +1 Armor
desc: Worn, it gives +1 AC on top of the armor's own.

name: +2 Armor
desc: Worn, it gives +2 AC on top of the armor's own.

name: +3 Armor
desc: Worn, it gives +3 AC on top of the armor's own.

name: Mithral Armor
desc: Light, supple metal: no Stealth disadvantage and no Strength requirement.

name: Adamantine Armor
desc: Worn, it turns critical hits against you into ordinary hits.

name: Armor of Resistance
desc: Worn and attuned: resistance to one damage type.

name: +1 Shield
desc: Held, it gives +1 AC on top of the usual +2 for a shield.

name: +2 Shield
desc: Held, it gives +2 AC on top of the usual +2 for a shield.

name: Sentinel Shield
desc: Held: advantage on initiative and on Perception checks.

name: Arrow-Catching Shield
desc: Held and attuned: +2 AC against ranged attacks, on top of the shield's own bonus. (Redirecting attacks aimed at others is left to the table.)

name: Cloak of Protection
desc: Worn and attuned: +1 to AC and to every saving throw.

name: Ring of Protection
desc: Worn and attuned: +1 to AC and to every saving throw.

name: Bracers of Defense
desc: Worn and attuned: +2 AC, but only while you have no armor on and no shield in hand.

name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
desc: Worn and attuned, they make your Strength 19 (no help if it's 19 or more already).

name: Headband of Intellect
desc: Worn and attuned, it makes your Intelligence 19 (no help if it's 19 or more already).

name: Amulet of Health
desc: Worn and attuned, it makes your Constitution 19 (no help if it's 19 or more already).

name: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
desc: Worn and attuned, it makes your Strength 21 (no help if it's 21 or more already).

name: Goggles of Night
desc: Worn, they grant darkvision to 60 ft, or extend darkvision you already have by 60 ft.

name: Boots of Striding and Springing
desc: Worn and attuned: walking speed at least 30 ft, and neither heavy armor nor a heavy load slows you.

name: Boots of Elvenkind
desc: Silent footsteps: advantage on Stealth checks to move quietly.

name: Cloak of Elvenkind
desc: Hood up, you are harder to spot: advantage on Stealth to hide, and others have disadvantage on Perception to see you.

name: Periapt of Wound Closure
desc: Attuned: when dying, you become stable at the start of your turn, and hit dice spent on healing restore double.

name: Brooch of Shielding
desc: Attuned: resistance to force damage, and magic missile darts can't hurt you.

name: Stone of Good Luck (Luckstone)
desc: Attuned and carried: +1 to ability checks and saving throws.

name: Ring of Warmth
desc: Worn and attuned: resistance to cold damage, and bitter cold doesn't harm you.

name: Ring of Resistance
desc: Worn and attuned: resistance to the damage type shown by its gem.

name: Bag of Holding
desc: Holds up to 500 lb and always weighs 15 lb, however full it is. Don't put it inside another extradimensional container.

name: Heward's Handy Haversack
desc: Holds up to 120 lb across its pouches and always weighs 5 lb, however full it is.

name: Driftglobe
desc: On its command word it glows: bright light 20 ft and dim light another 20 ft.

name: Boots of Speed
desc: Click the heels together (a bonus action) to double your walking speed; opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage. Up to 10 minutes (100 rounds) a day, in as many goes as you like; click again to stop.

name: Winged Boots
desc: Worn, they give you a flying speed equal to your walking speed, for up to 4 hours a day. Turning them on or off is a bonus action here.

name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
desc: When a ranged weapon attack hits you, your reaction knocks the damage down by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier (with a hand free).

name: Cloak of Displacement
desc: You seem to stand a little to one side of where you are: attacks against you have disadvantage. The trick stops after you take damage, until the start of your next turn, and while you're incapacitated, restrained or can't move.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
desc: 7 charges. An action and 1 charge casts magic missile at 1st level; each extra charge raises it a level (up to 3rd). Regains 1d6 + 1 charges at dawn. Spending the last charge risks it crumbling (a 1 on a d20).

name: Wand of Web
desc: 7 charges. An action and 1 charge casts web (DC 15). Regains 1d6 + 1 charges at dawn. Spending the last charge risks it crumbling (a 1 on a d20).

name: Wand of the War Mage, +1
desc: Held and attuned: +1 to spell attack rolls (half cover doesn't count against them).

name: Wand of the War Mage, +2
desc: Held and attuned: +2 to spell attack rolls (half cover doesn't count against them).

name: Rod of the Pact Keeper, +1
desc: Held and attuned by a warlock: +1 to spell attacks and to warlock spell save DCs. (Its once-a-day slot recovery is left to the table.)

name: Pearl of Power
desc: Attuned: an action restores one spent spell slot of 3rd level or lower. Once per day (it recharges at dawn).

name: Wand of Fireballs
desc: 7 charges. An action and 1 charge casts fireball (DC 15); each extra charge raises it a level. Regains 1d6 + 1 charges at dawn. Spending the last charge risks it crumbling (a 1 on a d20).

name: Necklace of Fireballs
desc: Hung with 1d6 + 3 beads. As an action, pull one off and throw it up to 60 feet: it bursts as a 3rd-level fireball (DC 15). Throwing more beads at once makes it one level stronger per extra bead. With no beads left the necklace is only a string.

name: Ring of Spell Storing
desc: Holds up to 5 levels' worth of spells. Outside a fight, a spellcaster wearing it can cast a spell into it (spending the slot). Whoever wears it and is attuned can then cast a stored spell, with the original caster's save DC, attack bonus and slot level.

name: Staff of the Woodlands
desc: A +2 quarterstaff; held, +2 to spell attacks. 10 charges (1d6 + 4 back at dawn): animal friendship (1), barkskin (2), wall of thorns (6), with your spell save DC. Its other powers (awaken, speak with animals or plants, pass without trace, tree form) are left to the table.
